what.value: Mission to define what one work item is as data, so a War Machine can select from the pool, check progress, and say why it chose it.
what.quote: **Serves:** our own War Machine first. Second, the consulting offer: "show me your agent logs and your ticket tracker, and I will show you how to make it work better" (pudding-prover T2.4/T2.5, `warm-customer-pays`; T∞).

area.quote: # M-giraffe — start from the data structure: a work pool the War Machine can read
